cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.
